thread:
ella (product): Heads up — were making a billing metering behavior change to reduce variance from short bursts. We'll move from a sliding 60s meter to a fixed 30s meter-clock for hosted API aggregation. Cutover planned 2026-05-02 05:00 UTC. Well enable a 24h provisional invoice-hold for any accounts with >6% or >$75 delta in their first post-cutover bill. Details & playbook below.
sam (finance): Quick: how will this appear on invoices and whats the reconciliation flow?
omar (billing): Invoice line: provisional-adjustment (metering-cutover) for reconciled amounts; provisional invoices held for 24h while we run an automated reconcile script. If variance >$150 or >15% we escalate to manual review.
tess (support): Need canned replies and opt-out for enterprise customers. Also request a short triage checklist for accounts that request expedited review.
ritesh (eng-infra): Technical notes: change is a config flip in metering-service and aggregator shards. Canary in us-west-2 first. Ill add per-route delta telemetry and a feature-flag kill switch. Rollback if error-rate >0.6% or billing-delta rate >0.8% accounts/hr.
ben (cto): Two asks: 1) preserve existing rate-limit headers so apps see no stricter limits; 2) retain per-account delta logs for 90 days for audits.
ella (product): Playbook summary:
1) 05:00 UTC: flip meter-clock in us-west-2-canary
2) 05:20: monitor delta & error budget, if OK -> 10% traffic to us-west-2
3) 05:50: if stable -> 50% then global ramp over 90m
4) If flagged accounts >0.5% of active customers -> enable invoice-hold and notify Finance + Support
5) Recon with audit script, publish provisional invoice, notify customer via email + support ticket
6) Post-rollout: Finance publishes reconciliation report within 72h
ritesh (eng-infra): Reconcile pseudo-snippet (audit-only mode first):
```
for acct in flagged:
  old = old_metering(acct)
  new = new_metering(acct)
  delta_pct = abs(new-old)/max(old,1)
  if delta_pct > 0.06 or abs(new-old) > 75:
    hold_invoice(acct)
    notify(finance, support, acct)
  else:
    emit_provisional_invoice(acct)
```
tess (support): Customer comms draft: "We're changing how short bursts are metered to make billing fairer. During the cutover some organizations may see a small adjustment; affected accounts will receive a provisional invoice and can request a manual review." Add: contact for urgent disputes and explicit no-double-billing guarantee.
sam (finance): Confirmed: waive late fees for provisional invoices created by this change; suppress immediate charge attempts for affected accounts for 48h; convert negative provisional invoices to account credit. Legal approved messaging.
omar (billing): Dashboard: Billing -> MeterCutover shows flagged accounts, hold status, and reconciliation progress. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/meter-cutover
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: metering-service v3.4.2 -> us-west-2-canary at 2026-05-02T05:00:00Z. Will emit events: canary-start, canary-stable, global-ramp, invoice-hold-enabled, reconciliation-complete.
ben (cto): Keep manual review conservative; automated recon should handle most cases. If we see patterns that look like exploitation, tighten thresholds immediately.
tess (support): We'll staff 05:00-11:00 UTC and watch #support-alerts for hold notifications. Please tag enterprise customers in the notification payload.
ella (product): I'll post the full FAQ & canned replies to the internal runbook (https://redwood.internal/docs/metering-cutover) and update this thread with status pings during the rollout. Thanks team.
